definitions.explanation: Sushi made by rolling vinegared rice and fillings in a sheet of seaweed (nori), then cutting it into rounds. A staple of Japanese home cooking and sushi restaurants.

examples.japanese: {巻|ま}き{寿司|ずし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
⟦{節分|せつぶん}→節分：18971_setsubun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{恵方|えほう}→恵方：12858_ehou⟧{巻|ま}き⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧{巻|ま}き{寿司|ずし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: On Setsubun, people eat a sushi roll called ehomaki.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦お{弁当|べんとう}→お弁当：02864_obentou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧{巻|ま}き{寿司|ずし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{卵焼|たまごや}き→卵焼き：10367_tamagoyaki⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧キュウリ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}っていて→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦{美味|おい}しかった→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧。
examples.english: The sushi rolls my mother put in my lunch box had egg omelet and cucumber in them and were delicious.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
{巻|ま}き (rolling) + {寿司|ずし} (sushi). Also written {巻|ま}きずし or {巻寿司|まきずし}.

USAGE:
{巻|ま}き{寿司|ずし} has several varieties based on thickness:
- ⟦{太巻|ふとま}き→太巻き：16202_futomaki⟧: thick roll with multiple fillings
- ⟦{細巻|ほそま}き→細巻き：21366_hosomaki⟧: thin roll with a single filling (e.g., ⟦かっぱ{巻|ま}き→かっぱ巻き：28783_kappamaki⟧ for cucumber, {鉄火|てっか}{巻|ま}き for tuna)
- {裏巻|うらま}き: inside-out roll (rice on outside)

Rolling is done with a {巻|ま}きす (bamboo rolling mat). {巻|ま}き{寿司|ずし} is commonly made at home for celebrations, parties, and ⟦{弁当|べんとう}→弁当：01014_bentou⟧ (lunch boxes).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {巻|ま}き{寿司|ずし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{巻|ま}く→巻く：02418_maku⟧: to roll sushi
- {巻|ま}き{寿司|ずし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧: to cut sushi rolls
- ⟦{手作|てづく}り→手作り：08300_tezukuri⟧{巻|ま}き{寿司|ずし}: homemade sushi rolls
